title: WHO List Title
body:
Syntax: title <text> | title color <name|0-255> | title clear

Titles appear ONLY after your character's name on WHO. No brackets are added automatically. They are grey by default, unless you explicitly choose another color using TITLE COLOR, or use inline MUD color codes.

Examples:
 title Shadow of Konoha       -> grey Shadow of Konoha
 title [Shadow of Konoha]     -> grey [Shadow of Konoha]
 title &RFlame &CIce           -> multicolor Flame Ice
 title color gold             -> sets your fallback title color

TITLE <new text> replaces an existing title immediately, no CLEAR required. Brackets count toward the 40-visible-character limit. Up to 16 valid inline color codes may be used. WHO titles never appear in CHATLOG, OOC, emotes, SCORE, LOOK, WHOIS, or other names. No raw terminal escapes are accepted.

Existing manually selected title colors are retained. New characters begin with grey. Settings persist through quit and reboot.
Date: 2026-11-02
